title: Identification and Expression Analysis of Cytoplasmic Membrane-Localized Protein STING
author: Shi, Liu, et al.

steps.title: Prepare culture media
steps.instruction: Make DMEM (Gibco) and RPMI‑1640 (Gibco) each supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum (Gibco) and 1 % Penicillin‑Streptomycin solution (Biosharp). Use the media for HEK293T and B16‑Blue™ ISG‑KO‑STING cells and maintain cultures at 37 °C, 5 % CO₂.

steps.title: Isolate human PBMCs
steps.instruction: Collect 3 mL peripheral blood into a 5 mL EDTA tube, add sterile PBS to a total volume of 6 mL, then gently layer 4 mL of this diluted blood onto 4 mL Ficoll‑Hypaque in a clean tube. Centrifuge at 300 g for 30 min at 25 °C. Transfer the intermediate cloudy (PBMC) layer to a new tube and centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min. Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL RBC lysis buffer for 2 min, centrifuge at 300 g, discard supernatant, and resuspend the cells in 5 mL PBS. Perform all steps under sterile conditions.

steps.title: Isolate mouse splenocytes
steps.instruction: Euthanize a C57BL/6J WT or C57BL/6J‑Sting1gt/J mouse, immerse the carcass in 75 % ethanol and expose the spleen. Remove the spleen, place it in sterile PBS and gently crush it with the inner piston of a syringe. Suspend the tissue in 10 mL PBS, filter through a 100 µm mesh, and centrifuge at 300 g for 10 min at 4 °C. Resuspend the pellet in 1 mL RBC lysis buffer for 2 min, centrifuge at 300 g, discard supernatant, repeat the 300 g spin, then resuspend the cells in 5 mL PBS. Finally, resuspend the splenocytes in 4 mL RPMI‑1640 and count them for downstream assays.

steps.title: Stain cells for flow cytometry
steps.instruction: Aliquot 1 × 10⁶ human PBMCs or mouse splenocytes per sample. Incubate the cells with 0.2 µg anti‑STING antibody (catalog 19851‑1‑AP; ab92605; NBP2‑24683), anti‑GAPDH antibody (60004‑1‑Ig), and rabbit IgG isotype (12‑370) diluted in PBS at 4 °C for 1 h. Wash twice with 1 mL PBS. Stain with FITC‑conjugated secondary antibody (SA00003‑2) diluted 1:200 in PBS at 25 °C in the dark for 1 h. Wash twice with PBS, centrifuging at 300 g for 5 min each wash. Resuspend the cells in 500 µL PBS, filter through a 50 µm mesh, acquire data on a BD LSR Fortessa, and analyze with FlowJo 10.6.1.

steps.title: Immunofluorescent co‑staining of splenocytes
steps.instruction: Prepare poly‑lysine‑treated slides. Pipette 30 µL of a suspension containing 1 × 10⁷ splenocytes in 1 mL PBS onto each slide, spread to form a monolayer and air‑dry at 25 °C. Draw a hydrophobic barrier around the dried spot. Fix cells with 2 % cold paraformaldehyde for 5 min, then block with 1 % BSA in PBS for 30 min. Wash twice with cold PBS (cells submerged). Incubate with anti‑STING antibody (ab189430) diluted 1:200 in PBS at 4 °C for 14 h. Without washing, add fluorochrome‑conjugated antibodies at 4 °C in the dark for 30 min: FITC‑anti‑mouse CD3 (1:50, catalog 100204), FITC‑anti‑mouse CD19 (1:50, catalog 115506), FITC‑anti‑mouse CD11b (1:200, catalog 101206). Wash three times with cold PBST (cells submerged). Incubate with Alexa Fluor 594‑goat anti‑rabbit IgG (ab150080) diluted 1:200 at 25 °C in the dark for 1 h. Stain nuclei with DAPI at 25 °C for 10 min (adjust time to avoid overstaining). Perform a final wash with cold PBST, mount with a sealing agent, and capture images using a Nikon C2 confocal microscope.
